registration.notes: Deployment status composition (ADR_UGENCE_MODULE_ADMINISTRATION_SCOPING.md MA-2 as amended by MS-1 to MS-5 as ruled: SEAM_STATES_ONLY, IN_MEMORY_RESULT_AT_COMPOSITION, OBSERVE_DEPLOYMENT_ONE_READ, SEAM_STATES_CHECKS_AND_PINS, SEPARATE_STATUS_PANEL): build_studio_context receives one further seam, deployment_report - the startup integrity report the gate computed before the port bound, handed once by server.run() as a dict and copied by the backend; no file under the runtime volume is read by any route, no package is imported for it and no SD-1 entry is added. The frozen v2 contract is amended a seventh time (v2-A7) by one read, v2_observe_deployment, which returns the six seam states, the checks map, the gate result and failure code and the pins; cert_subject and cert_expiry do not travel; the console's nine module rows are struck by MS-1 and reach the studio by no ruled path; nothing is probed at request time and the answer carries the STARTUP_ATTESTATION ceiling saying a configured seam is not a reachable engine. The panel is /studio/status, separate from Observe, whose two labelled sources are unchanged (FD-11.4). No configuration value, image package, credential, LIVE path or egress destination is added, and decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. Supersedes the seam-10 registration, which is never edited.
